comparison_to_206901.interpretation: 206901 is consistent with rounding the nominal-platform scenario root upward to an integer second. This is a possible explanation, not evidence of the assumptions used by another person.
comparison_to_206901.geometry_warning: The 80x64 isothermal-after-6h cylinder root is 206901.783371 s. Its raw difference from fine 1D combines about +3.049542 s radial discretization and -7.660840 s matched-grid end effect; do not attribute the combined difference entirely to geometry.
